entities.summary: Mikhail Vasilyevich Butashevich-Petrashevsky, commonly known as Mikhail Petrashevsky, was a Russian Utopian theorist, best known for his central role in the activities of the Petrashevsky Circle, a literary discussion group in Saint Petersburg in the 1840s.
